CS 1400.title: Fundamentals of Programming
CS 1400.prereqText: Math at least equivalent to high school algebra and trigonometry. CS 1030 recommended.
prereqWords: Math at least equivalent to high school algebra and trigonometry

CS 1410.title: Object Oriented Programming
CS 1410.prereqText: CS 1400 and Math equivalent to at least college algebra

CS 1420.title: Accelerated Introduction to Programming
CS 1420.prereqText: Math at least equivalent to college algebra. Pass CS 1420 Entrance Exam.
prereqWords: Math at least equivalent to college algebra

CS 2300.title: Discrete Mathematical Structures I
CS 2300.prereqText: ( CS 1410 or INFO 2200 ) and MATH 1050 or higher

CS 2420.title: Introduction to Algorithms and Data Structures

CS 3050G.title: Global Social and Ethical Issues in Computing
CS 3050G.prereqText: ENGL 2010 and ( CS 1030 or CS 1400 or CS 1420 or INFO 1120 or DGM 1110 ) and University Advanced Standing

CS 3270.title: Python Software Development
CS 3270.prereqText: CS 2420 or INFO 2200 , matriculation to computer science or software engineering if computer science or software engineering major, and University Advanced Standing

ENGL 2010.title: Intermediate Academic Writing
ENGL 2010.prereqText: Appropriate ACT test scores taken within the last three years or completion of ENGL 1010 or ENGL 1010H with a grade of C- or higher, or ENGH 1005 with a grade of C or higher.

MATH 1210.title: Calculus I
MATH 1210.prereqText: One of the following within the past two years: ( MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 ) and MATH 1060 , each with a grade of C or higher; OR MATH 1080 with a grade of C or higher; OR appropriate placement by math placement test.
prereqWords: appropriate placement by math placement test

MATH 1220.title: Calculus II
MATH 1220.prereqText: MATH 1210 or MATH 1210H with a grade of C or higher

MATH 2210.title: Calculus III
MATH 2210.prereqText: MATH 1220 or MATH 1220H with a grade of C or higher

MATH 2270.title: Linear Algebra
MATH 2270.prereqText: MATH 1210 or MATH 1210H with a grade of C or higher

MATH 3640.title: Introduction to Optimization
MATH 3640.prereqText: ( MATH 2210 or MATH 2210H ) and MATH 2270 with a grade of C or higher and University Advanced Standing; CS 1400 with a grade of C or higher is recommended.

STAT 2050.title: Introduction to Statistical Methods
STAT 2050.prereqText: Within the past two years, MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 or MATH 1080 with a grade of C or higher or appropriate math placement test score.
